chunks: And who is more unjust than he who fabricates a lie about Allah or denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not an abode for the disbelievers in Hell?
ai.seo_question: Who is considered the most unjust person according to this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *al-Haqq* (the Truth), referring specifically to the Prophet and the Ahl al-Bayt, making the rejection of their authority a form of lying against God. It underscores the gravity of *iftira'* (fabrication) as the root of disbelief, warning that those who distort divine truth face an eternal abode in Hell. This serves as a theological foundation for understanding the consequences of rejecting the Imamate and the prophetic message.
